Guyon Gazebo is a luxurious display font has a unique style makes it great for creating bold headlines, branding, promotional materials or simply as a stylish text overlay to any background image. This font comes with high contrast strokes and has a slender stem and pointed terminals.

The Guyon Gazebo font has many standard and discretionary ligatures that will make your designs more attractive.

What’s included:

• Gazebo Regular & Italic
• Full set of basic Latin+
• Ligatures
• Numeral & punctuation
• Multilingual Support

About Guyon Gazebo: 

Guyon or it can also be said "Guyonan" has the meaning of joking. Can be done by one person (Stand-up Comedy) or by several people. The origin of the word Guyon itself comes from the Javanese language. 

In rural areas, there is generally a traditional gazebo called "Cakruk". That is a place to sit back or a post standby at night. Sometimes, it is also a place for jokes (guyonan) between local residents in the afternoon or evening.

If you have any questions, please send a message.
Thank you
